provenance.use: the --budget-level check of froq/u6.py (check_budget_level): B = ceil(level x P)
provenance.source: P, the peak decoder demand per program and d: the largest number of decoders SWIPER alone (N) uses at once (decoder.max_parallel_decoders) in a seed-1 run with unlimited decoders. The budgets 0.5P, 0.75P, P and 1.5P follow from it.
provenance.qpeexact_20: qpeexact_20 at d = 13, 17 and 21: P = 89, 117 and 159, the max_parallel_decoders of the seed-1 N runs with unlimited decoders
provenance.other_d: d = 15, 19 and 23 for the nine programs: P = decoder.max_parallel_decoders of N at seed 1 without --budget, with --client swiper, --hw-limits improved and the f-flip rate of that d; the same command at d = 13 reproduces the file's P for adder_16, adder_32, adder_4, adder_8, grover_ancilla_5 and qpeexact_10
